title: At school and university
descriptionFa: اسم درس‌ها، وسایل کلاس، و درس خوندن و امتحان دادن.

words.example: Our English teacher speaks only English in class.
words.tipFa: اسم زبان‌ها با حرف بزرگ نوشته می‌شه.

words.example: I'm good at maths but bad at spelling.
Physics explains why things fall to the ground.
words.tipFa: با s تموم می‌شه ولی مفرده: Physics is difficult.

words.example: In chemistry we mixed two liquids and they turned blue.
In biology we looked at cells under a microscope.
We're learning about the Safavid kings in history.
Our geography teacher showed us a map of the Zagros Mountains.
In art we painted a picture of a flower.
We sing songs in music lessons.
In ICT we learned how to make a website.
We play volleyball in PE on Mondays.
She teaches modern languages: French and German.
The teacher wrote the new words on the whiteboard.
This board pen doesn't work. Have you got another one?
The exam timetable is on the noticeboard.
Fix the poster to the wall with a drawing pin.
Please sit at your desk.
Open your textbook at page twenty.
Write the new words in your notebook.
Can I have a piece of paper? I want to write a note.
words.tipFa: paper غیرقابل‌شمارشه: a piece of paper، نه a paper (a paper یعنی «روزنامه»).

words.example: Can I borrow your pen?
Use a pencil so you can change your answer later.
I made a mistake. Can I borrow your rubber?
My pencil is broken. Have you got a pencil sharpener?
Draw a straight line with a ruler.
In Iran, children go to school at the age of seven.
words.tipFa: بدون the. برای دانشگاه هم همینه: go to university.

words.example: My aunt wants to teach English in Japan.
My cousin wants to study medicine in Tabriz.
It's never too late to learn a new language.
words.tipFa: study یعنی «درس خوندن»؛ learn یعنی «یاد گرفتن» (نتیجه‌ش).

words.example: Children usually do homework after school.
words.tipFa: do homework، نه make homework. homework غیرقابل‌شمارشه: نه homeworks.

words.example: My mother wants to do a course in photography.
Students take an exam at the end of each term.
words.tipFa: do an exam هم می‌گن. «امتحان گرفتن» (کار معلم) می‌شه give an exam.

words.example: Did you pass your driving test?
He didn't study, so he will probably fail.
words.tipFa: fail an exam، نه fail in an exam.

words.example: She wants to get a degree in engineering.
words.tipFa: لیسانس: a bachelor's degree، فوق‌لیسانس: a master's degree.
